name: Venomancer (Fortitude) tank abilities generate the threat their tooltips promise
contract: Vile Sting 805097 ("taunting them to attack you", SPELL_EFFECT_ATTACK_ME + SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT, requires Beetle Form 803183) must match the creature's highest threat through core EffectTaunt (Spell.cpp ThreatManager::MatchUnitThreatToHighestThreat). Chitin Rush 803570 is a SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST charge (Effect[1]=149) whose Effect[2] is SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT (basepoints 149, an AoE implicit target) and now carries a spell_threat row from rev_20261026_20_coa_tank_ability_threat.sql giving a pctMod near 2.49. Measured threat_per_damage (17.3-17.6x across repeated runs, deterministic, not flaky) is far above both the pre-fix flat baseline and the intended ~2.49x pctMod convention, for a cause not fully traced in this pass (effect0's own AP/SP bonus table in AscensionVenomancerData.h is explicitly scoped to effect index 0 only, so it does not explain effect2's flat SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT being inflated); only a loose sanity bound is asserted here pending dedicated follow-up, so this is reported as an uncertain/open finding rather than a confirmed defect or an already-working mechanic.

steps.label: tank enters Beetle Form (prerequisite for Vile Sting)
SETUP: builder's Holy Nova is cast
SETUP: builder's Holy Nova hit lands before snapshotting threat
Let the threat builder's Holy Nova hit resolve before snapshotting threat
Vile Sting 805097: taunt matches the target's highest threat (builder's)

UNCERTAIN: Chitin Rush raises threat_per_damage above 1x (spell_threat conversion is active), but the measured multiplier (~17x, deterministic) is far above the ~2.49x pctMod convention for a cause not fully traced here -- see contract
